name: shop-with-openmerchant-custom
description: Find products from merchants that sell through OpenMerchant, prepare a checkout, and complete the purchase in the conversation with a payment credential your app holds. Card numbers never pass through the chat.

interface.longDescription: Everything in Shop with OpenMerchant, plus completing the purchase in the conversation when your app can supply a payment credential the merchant accepts, such as a Stripe Shared Payment Token. Without one, the shopper finishes on the merchant's site. Card numbers never pass through the chat, and no OpenMerchant account is needed.
defaultPrompt: Find a ceramic pour-over coffee dripper under $40.
Which stores here sell trail running shoes?
Check out the cart and ship it to my office.
